subject: mathematics
explanation:
Given that $\vec{SP} + 5\vec{SQ} + 6\vec{SR} = \vec{0}$.
Taking position vector with origin at $S$, we have:
$$\vec{p} + 5\vec{q} + 6\vec{r} = \vec{0} \implies \vec{p} + 6\vec{r} = -5\vec{q}$$
Let $E$ be the midpoint of $PR$, so $\vec{e} = \frac{\vec{p} + \vec{r}}{2}$.
Let $F$ be the midpoint of $QR$, so $\vec{f} = \frac{\vec{q} + \vec{r}}{2}$.
The line segment $\vec{EF} = \vec{f} - \vec{e} = \frac{\vec{q} - \vec{p}}{2}$.
Using vector relations and calculating the lengths:
$$\frac{\text{length of } EF}{\text{length of } ES} = \frac{6}{5} = 1.20$$
